name: Przedsiebiorstwo Produkcyjno - Handlowe KOMPAP S.A.
summary: Przedsiebiorstwo Produkcyjno - Handlowe KOMPAP S.A., founded in 1989 and headquartered in Laskowice, Poland, is a leading producer and vendor of printed materials, serving both domestic and international markets. Operating under its Kompap, BZGraf, and OZGraf brands, the company offers a comprehensive array of products. This includes informational and instructional prints such as leaflets, brochures, and user manuals specifically designed for pharmaceutical and cosmetic companies. They also supply business stationery like A4 letterheads suitable for laser printers, alongside various administrative and operational documents for accounting, HR, payroll, warehouse management, and sales. KOMPAP specializes in self-adhesive labels, provided in sheets, rolls, or continuous forms, for diverse sectors including offices, logistics, and public administration. Additional offerings feature specialized paper rolls for fiscal cash registers and ATMs, custom-printed computer papers, and secure confidential envelopes. The firm further produces packaging papers in rolls or sheets, publishes books, magazines, and albums, and provides general printing services. Its diverse client base includes companies in the printing, transport, logistics, pharmaceutical, service, and food industries, as well as paper wholesalers.
